paper_title: Improved axion emissivity from a supernova via nucleon-nucleon bremsstrahlung
notes: SN 1987A bound on axion-nucleon coupling from improved nucleon-nucleon bremsstrahlung emissivity calculation. Paper assumes g_an = g_ap throughout. Bound from Section 3: g_an = g_ap ≲ 6×10^{-10} (improved from naive OPE ≲ 2×10^{-10}), derived from Eq. (3.3) requiring L_a ≲ 2×10^{52} erg/s. Applies to free-streaming regime where m_a < ~0.1 eV (Section 4); trapped axion regime above this has more complex constraints shown in Figure 15. Flat limit plotted over free-streaming mass range 1 μeV to 0.1 eV. Model-dependent bounds for KVSZ/DFSZ shown in Tables 1-2 and Figure 17.
